summary.name: Cognosys AI
summary.one_liner: Cognosys is a closed-source, web-based no-code UI for running AI agents (a web version of AutoGPT/babyAGI), described in an E2B interview with its CEO Sully Omar about deployment, observability, evals and latency.
use_cases: running an AI research agent that searches the internet and cites sources
letting non-technical users run agents for daily tasks
learning how a startup deployed LLM agents on cloud infrastructure
understanding challenges of evaluating and tracing autonomous agents
summary.what_it_does: Cognosys provides a web UI for creating AI agents that work in loops: they break a high-level objective into smaller tasks, call an LLM, and iterate until the task is done. The page says the process takes seconds and requires no coding. Its most popular agent is an internet research agent that synthesizes web research and links to sources. The interview also covers the company's infrastructure: it moved from Vercel edge functions (60-second timeout) and Cloud Functions to a Cloud Run instance behind an API Gateway, and it uses mainly its own UI for tracing agent runs. It retries failed agent steps and asks users to rerun the agent rather than showing error details.
notable: Web-based no-code interface built on the AutoGPT/babyAGI loop concept
Internet research agent that synthesizes findings and provides source links
Runs on Google Cloud Run behind an API Gateway, per the interview
Interview with CEO Sully Omar on deployment, evals, and latency, published by E2B
caveats: Agent runs typically take 60 seconds to 5 minutes, which the CEO says users find frustrating
Page does not state pricing or plans
